name: Jason George
bio: Jason Winston George (born February 9, 1972) is an American actor and model. He is best known for his roles as Dr. Ben Warren on Grey's Anatomy and its spinoff Station 19, Justin Russell in Breaking In, David in Kidnap, Detective Adam Noble on Lifetime's fantasy series Witches of East End, Dominic Taylor on ABC's drama Mistresses, Dr. Otis Cole on ABC's Off the Map, Keith Bennett on ABC's series Eli Stone, Jeremy on ABC's drama What About Brian?, Jeremiah Thurgood "J.T." Hunter on UPN's sitcom Eve, Kevin in Barbershop, Scott Littleton on NBC's series Titans, and Michael Bourne on the NBC daytime soap opera Sunset Beach.
